mapper.sql: f.id, f.name, f.image_url AS image, f.description, f.ai_summary AS aiSummary, f.rating AS score, f.rating AS rating, f.price_level AS priceLevel, f.avg_price AS avgPrice, 0 AS distance, f.cuisine_code AS cuisine, f.cuisine_name AS cuisineName, f.cuisine_name AS cuisine_type, CASE WHEN f.rating >= 4.5 OR f.hotness >= 500 THEN true ELSE false END AS recommend, f.address, f.longitude, f.latitude, DATE_FORMAT(f.open_time, '%H:%i') AS openTime, DATE_FORMAT(f.close_time, '%H:%i') AS closeTime, f.phone, f.hotness, COALESCE(s.id, p.id) AS spot_id, COALESCE(s.name, p.name) AS spot_name

choose.when: ORDER BY f.hotness DESC, f.rating DESC, f.id ASC
ORDER BY distance ASC, f.rating DESC, f.hotness DESC, f.id ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY f.rating DESC, f.hotness DESC, f.id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.image_url AS image, f.description, f.ai_summary AS aiSummary, f.cuisine_code AS cuisine, f.cuisine_name AS cuisineName, f.cuisine_name AS cuisine_type, f.rating AS score, f.rating AS rating, f.hotness, f.price_level AS priceLevel, f.avg_price AS avgPrice, f.address, f.longitude, f.latitude, DATE_FORMAT(f.open_time, '%H:%i') AS openTime, DATE_FORMAT(f.close_time, '%H:%i') AS closeTime, f.phone, COALESCE(s.id, p.id) AS spot_id, COALESCE(s.name, p.name) AS spot_name FROM foods f LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = f.poi_id LEFT JOIN spots s ON s.id = p.spot_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.status = 1
SELECT ai_summary FROM foods WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE foods SET ai_summary = #{summary} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.image_url AS image, f.description, f.rating AS score, f.rating AS rating, f.hotness, f.cuisine_code AS cuisine, f.cuisine_name AS cuisineName, f.price_level AS priceLevel FROM foods f WHERE f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.rating DESC, f.hotness DESC, f.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT f.id, f.name, f.image_url AS image, f.description, f.rating AS score, f.rating AS rating, f.hotness, f.cuisine_code AS cuisine, f.cuisine_name AS cuisineName, f.price_level AS priceLevel FROM foods f WHERE f.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_reviews (food_id, user_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{foodId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content})
